name: deploy-pipeline
description: Full deployment pipeline: test → build → deploy

template.subject: Deploy to {{environment}}
template.body: Execute full deployment pipeline for {{environment}}: 1) Run test suite (fail fast on errors) 2) Build application 3) Run database migrations if needed 4) Deploy to {{environment}} 5) Run smoke tests 6) Send deployment notification with version number and changelog. Rollback on any failures.
